fast.why: A no-op plugin that fills out the eleven-plugin containment list.

keyhog.why: Claims Tab always and consumes it (shared-key theft).

looper.why: Busy-waits on a key: CPU containment.

slow50.why: A slow async edit: only the latest result may apply (C3).

stale.why: Effects against an old version: all dropped (C3).

thrower.why: Throws on every change: disabled without hurting peers.

hostile.why: The r14 attack plugin; settings.mode picks the attack.

rules.why: Small plugins for the third-party rule groups; settings.mode picks one.

edits.why: One edit on a trigger, interleaved appends, and a change recorder: commit failures, undo order, pending merge.

conflicts.why: Two plugins answering the same trigger, and a submit guard: plugin order.

names-claim.why: Consumes Tab only at a code-like word; prose Tab still passes.

provided.autocorrect: Our autocorrect plugin (phase 13); the prototype is shared-v2/plugins/autocorrect.ts.
provided.shortcuts: Our shortcuts plugin (phase 15); compile + inline registration.
provided.menu: The `;` menu (phase 16). Separate plugin ID so it can be turned off alone.
provided.snippets: Same factory as menu; kept so C5–C7 and older cases keep running.
provided.rescue: Our draft rescue plugin (phase 17); idle save, Tab restore, size and private gates.
provided.phrases: Our phrase ghost plugin (phase 34); learns from sends, shows a ghost after a typing pause.
provided.names: Our project-name menu (phase 36); on-request, never an automatic edit.
provided.counter: The status counter sample ("N chars"); prototype shared-v2/plugins/counter.ts, an API sample in phase 03.
provided.todo-guard: The TODO guard API sample: blocks a send that says TODO; the required guard in the submit cases.
